title: Strengthening Behavioral Health Parity Act

summaries.text:
Strengthening Behavioral Health Parity Act

 This bill establishes compliance mechanisms related to the requirements for health insurance plans that cover mental health or substance use disorder services to provide such coverage in a manner consistent with the coverage of other medical and surgical services under their plans.
